scope: Deterministic AI-only comparison with actual authoritative rules; not a human win-rate or ranked-balance estimate.

design.upgrades: Bots do not purchase upgrades. All actors start at base rank.

limitations: Two seeds and a fixed three-hero benchmark cannot establish matchup fairness or human skill ceilings.
Mirrored sides and all three lanes reduce position bias but do not eliminate bot targeting or kit-use bias.
Support cast starts count accepted cooldown starts, including interrupted windups; they do not measure effective support.
Observed team healing is positive net health change outside bases, excludes respawn, and can undercount concurrent damage. It is not attributed to the focal hero.
Observed shield additions outside bases include abilities and neutral pickups and exclude respawn. They are not attributed to the focal hero.
Object destruction and core damage are team outcomes, not individual credit. No automatic tuning is performed from this report.

disparitiesForReview.interpretation: Inspect these as bot-policy and tuning leads. Do not label heroes overpowered or fair from this small scripted matrix.
